about: Contradictions in the platform's architecture data that are known and waiting on a decision by the owner. scripts/check-architecture.mjs fails the build on any contradiction not listed here, and on any entry here that no longer occurs. Pages show each one where it applies.

questions.question: Moldloft commits the generated repository to Plainforge, but workers cannot reach Plainforge. Either open that path for this worker, or have a control-plane service make the commit.
Chartroom writes catalog entries to the hub repository in Plainforge, but workers cannot reach Plainforge. Either open that path for this worker, or have a control-plane service make the commit.
Bellbuoy commits changes and opens tasks in Plainforge, but workers cannot reach Plainforge. Either open that path for this worker, or have a control-plane service make the commit.
Chartroom takes items in a state called verified, which is not one of the fourteen. Should Shakedown's pass be a state of its own, or should Chartroom take building items that passed?
Plainforge mirrors the code to GitHub, and Bellbuoy has a github-mirror sub-tool as well. Which one owns the mirror?
